conceptual_statement: New York’s strongest Trust Hub evidence is a public-work contractor certificate registry that is not a residential HIC license, a search-only NYSDOT household-goods roster with 2026 bulletin application observations that are not current movers, NYSDOH nursing-home and adult-care grains that must not be added, dated DFS lender aggregates plus HMDA applications that are not current licenses, a DFS insurance company directory that is not current writing authority, and IAPD state-IA/ERA/notice/office lenses that cannot collapse into one adviser census.
